items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: So we went to the telegraph office and we sent Fletcher a night letter, see? Explaining everything to him.

ctx.x: Oh man, good. Very good. But Fletcher Henderson sent for Louis and Louis showed me the telegram that Fletcher wanted Louis to join him in New York. And old Louis told me, he said, I'm not going if you don't go.

So we went to the telegraph office and we sent Fletcher a night letter, see? Explaining everything to him. And that's when Fletcher wrote back and he said that he had had a drummer that he had had so long which was Kaiser Marshall. And I really didn't want Louis to draw me on Fletcher then you know.
Louis said, well man, you've got rhythm, all you need is to play that rhythm and that's it. I said, no, but that fell through anyway because Fletcher didn't want to change …….
